caption: The drawing depicts a round tray or platter with an ornate, scalloped edge and intricate decorative patterns around the border. The tray is shown from two perspectives: a top view and a side view. In the top view, the tray features a central emblem consisting of a pair of wings or stylized feathers. The scalloped edge is adorned with flowing, curved scrollwork and floral-like designs. The side view below shows the tray resting on three small, curved legs, each with additional decorative detailing. The drawing is rendered in monochrome shades of grey and black on a beige background, with careful shading to indicate texture and depth. The tray occupies the majority of the space within a thin rectangular border that frames the composition.
title: Silver Tray
